summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for their third home game in eleven days as they host New Mills at Hind Heath Road with a 7.45pm kick-off, with both sides currently level on 6 points after the opening fixtures of the 2026/27 season. The fixture promises to be a competitive encounter given the intensity of this particular rivalry and the closely matched points tallies. Supporters are encouraged to get down to the ground to back The Bach in what should be a tight affair.
